scope.title: Model-call cost correlation and bounded redacted trace sampling
scope.source: deterministic local fixture + in-process local HTTP OTLP collector (no live provider)

decision.reason: Ported onto current origin/main; all O02 required tests, runtime types, oxlint, harness validate/dry-run and comms replay/compare passed on a clean candidate commit. No product lock or default changed; no live-provider or human claim.

runtimeEvidence.collector: in-process Node http server on 127.0.0.1 acting as a neutral OTLP collector (createserver/listen, raw protobuf captured and written to otlp-<n>.bin)
runtimeEvidence.recompute: same redacted OTLP event set re-derives identical measured cost
runtimeEvidence.sampling: per retained sample records reason/probability/policy version; pre-sampling denominator and unsampled/unknown/duplicate/dropped counted separately

independentVerification.detail: The plugin test re-derives cost from the captured OTLP payload and asserts it equals the emitted cost; the unit test captures the real OTLP HTTP bodies. No separate second-agent verifier role was run this session.

acceptanceCriteria.note: Enabled only when config.diagnostics.otel.enabled === true AND the trace.cost-sampling diagnostic flag is set; default/off path keeps original events and export behavior.

run/session/request/attempt hashed with a domain-separated SHA256; toolCallId digest links the tool span; no prompt/tool body/auth headers/raw ids in new trace; effect keeps existing OTel parent chain.

Consumes only final done/error structured usage; cache and non-cache tokens separate; duplicate terminals not accumulated; out-of-order partial does not override terminal; missing/invalid explicit as not-measured; stream value/count/error/cancel unchanged.
USD-per-million-token rate snapshot with a content-digest version; missing/invalid/all-zero unknown price -> costUsd = null; original usage.cost untouched.

Sampling at the single OTel exit with a fixed seed + traceId; errors/refusals/recovery never dropped by probability; retained sample carries reason/probability/policy version; denominator and unknown/duplicate/dropped counted separately.
Queue cap 1024, batch cap 512, retention 300000ms, evict ordinary success first, explicit over-budget/expiry/export-failure counters; dedupe history 4096/300000ms with a retirement watermark.
Local deterministic fixture: association 100% with no budget overflow and zero duplicate billing; identical redacted OTLP set re-derives the same measured cost.
Real producer + plugin service exercised through a local neutral HTTP OTLP collector; success/error/refusal/recovery/cancel/duplicate/out-of-order/expiry/budget/export-failure/close-rollback covered.
Clean candidate commit; focused tests + types + lint + harness + comms passed; credential scan 0 hits.
